name: SpiralHookV2 spot-price borrow with tx.origin same-block guard
summary: SpiralHookV2.borrow values SPIRAL collateral at the live slot0 price of its own Uniswap V4 pool, and its only same-block defence keys lastSwapBlockOf on tx.origin. The attacker pumped the pool from one EOA, then borrowed hook-owned ETH against the bought SPIRAL at the inflated spot from six other EOAs through one contract in the same block.
notes: Owner launch steps after deployment (initializePool, seedBands, openTrading) only bind the hook to its own pool and open trading; the spot-price valuation and tx.origin guard are immutable code, so deployment is the reset.

The six borrows paid the attacker 64.707 ETH net of origination fees to the protocol's buyback. The 52.92 ETH its pump put into the pool is a round trip of its own funds and is offset; the 1.08 ETH swap fee it paid is a fee and is not. The SPIRAL collateral left behind is not netted.
